title: Create snake.html — a single-file, playable Snake game using an HTML5 canvas and vanilla JavaScript. Arrow keys steer the snake; eating food grows the snake and increments a visible score; colliding with a wall or the snake's own body ends the game and shows a Game Over message with a way to restart (e.g. press Space or R). No external libraries and no build step — all HTML, CSS, and JS inline in one snake.html file at the repo root.
